conditions: Explicit document/window/clock/storage/clientFactory collaborators; synthetic host has no network or GPU
The transport supplies validated job IDs, status, request deadlines, authenticated media verification and unknown POST evidence
The API returns instance_id and queue.admission_open; model_ready false alone does not prevent queue admission
Compatible GET /v1/capabilities schema 1 reports ref2va/bf16 and configured trusted options; no capability record grants authority to load an arbitrary adapter or change precision
Capability identity is required and must equal the parallel system observation; quantization must explicitly be false

interface.refresh: onChange({kind:'video-update'}) reports an incremental patch; the caller must not rebuild the whole form for polling updates

observations: Independent queue records and existing conversation storage
Cancellation request distinct from final cancellation
Capability discovery preserves configured versus ready: model download does not block admitted queue submissions
Explicit per-task attention_backend, acceleration_lora and steps; Turbo requires 5 schedule points / 4 model evaluations with no implicit step edit
Requested execution options and effective GPU-applied receipt remain separate facts
Each upload captures primitive options before dispatch; later form changes do not rewrite queued requested settings
Malformed or contradictory generation receipts report a separate configuration warning while preserving query/cancel/download access and already observed execution configuration
Only confirmed cancelled + exact result_not_committed is presented as cancellation without a committed artifact; pending cancellation and all other error codes retain their actual meaning
limits: Synthetic acceptance cannot prove real A100 inference, Cloudflare availability, final video quality or browser-specific file delivery
API keys and selected files are memory-only; reloading requires reauthentication and file reselection for new submissions
The API cannot find unknown submissions by idempotency key; a lost receipt without job ID requires obtaining the original ID from the service

Task records have no fixed count limit but browser storage quota can fail visibly; malformed prior storage is preserved. New POSTs require a successful pre-dispatch unknown-request journal write; unavailable storage prevents upload
The 256 MiB budget counts retained and reserved in-flight payload bytes; browser decoder, stream, hash and Blob implementation overhead is additional, not an exact process-heap ceiling
The browser stops querying on dispose; it does not claim remote GPU cancellation or resource release
question: 如何在极简界面中分别拥有上传回执、服务端任务观察、取消请求及本机视频交付？

stateModel.budget: 3 simultaneous job observations, exponential backoff capped at 60 seconds plus Retry-After; up to 2 simultaneous authenticated media fetches sharing a 256 MiB payload budget with retained media; at most 3 retained Blob URLs. Downloads reserve artifact bytes before dispatch, release the reservation on every completion path, and wait when insufficient budget remains. Jobs have no fixed count cap. Key/file/prompt content is not persisted.
stateModel.persistence: Dedicated llm-video-v1 path namespace saves endpoint, instance identity, job ID/status/timestamps and idempotency identity, separate from existing chat/image archives
stateModel.ownership: Endpoint credentials and observed instance IDs authorize subsequent effects. Instance mismatch pauses observation/control. Blob URLs are owned, evicted and revoked by the workspace. DOM patching does not replace focused form inputs or existing video elements.

counterexamples: API connected or model downloaded does not prove queue admission, inference completion, media delivery or cleanup
Unknown submission does not authorize retrying POST; unknown cancellation does not mean cancelled. The pre-POST request journal survives closure while an upload acknowledgement is pending
An unverified or nonexistent recovery candidate ID does not bind the unknown request or remove duplicate-submission protection
A task with the same endpoint after server restart does not belong to the new instance
Leaving the video tab does not cancel its remote jobs or discard task ownership
An accepted task queue without a count cap does not imply unbounded retained media memory
A missing clipboard API does not produce a successful copy receipt
A late connection result or disposed async callback cannot overwrite current credentials or create an unowned Blob URL
An unauthorized response for an older credential cannot revoke a newer connection; pre-cancellation queries cannot roll back cancellation receipts
A configured but not yet ready Turbo adapter permits queuing; ready false does not mean unsupported
Capability discovery failure blocks new uploads, not authorized observation, cancellation or download of existing jobs
Choosing Turbo at 50 steps does not authorize silently changing to five steps
A capability response without instance_id does not authorize a new upload
A late capability 401 or stale capability receipt cannot replace a newer connection
A malformed precision field must not crash task rendering or make a known accepted task appear unsubmitted
Connection-time capability readiness does not establish current model readiness during later tasks
Manager status running with no active_phase does not establish GPU inference; gpu_wait is resource waiting, and encode_validate is a separate CPU phase
extensionSeam: Service, clock and browser ownership boundaries are explicit collaborators; added server phases must preserve observed versus inferred status

proofObligations.statement: Local host shows declared submission/query/cancellation/media observations under synthetic conditions
Local lifecycle and transport evidence do not prove provider capacity, all-browser behavior or semantic generation success

observations: Synthetic job lifecycle with explicit effects and failure exits
assumptions: Ordinary JavaScript/browser collaborator behavior; no adversarial Proxy mutation
